text:
Welcome to Israel! Hope you are settling in okay. For your questions: 

1) In my experience they don't really check this part at all, but you should write B1. 

2) Yes this first page is just a checklist that you can leave blank.

3) You should try and have this filled out by the owner of wherever you are living at the moment. I think the specific address you include for it is not so crucial - so I would think it's probably okay to write the Tel Aviv parents' address if you are living there for the time being. Some branches do not treat this part of the AS/6 as so crucial in any case (i.e. they may not require verification by a lawyer etc.) So you can try submit what you have and then see what they say.
